subject: Acceleron — volume-tier structure & price exception request

From: Sam Liu <sam.liu@acceleronpharma.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging question — annual commitment and tiered usage

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. We ran a model for year-one usage and the numbers are looking promising — we expect to hit ~120M tokens/month by Q4 if the pilot scales. Before legal and procurement start the SOW, procurement asked whether Redwood can do: 

- a blended volume tier that preserves a lower per-token rate for 0–50M, then a steeper discount for 50–150M, and
- a one-time onboarding credit to offset the initial fine-tuning/embedding costs.

Their concern is the mid-year step-up where our consumption jumps and the list card doesn't map cleanly. Can you escalate for an exception or suggest alternate packaging? We need a commercial position to share with procurement by next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Liu
Senior Manager, Platform Engineering
Acceleron Pharma

Ben / Laura — forwarding Acceleron request. Key ask: blended tier for 0–50M and 50–150M and an onboarding credit to cover FT/embeddings. They expect ~120M/month later in year.

Why I think we should consider:
- Strategic: Acceleron is a high-profile pharma account (pilot with two molecules).
- Upside: multi-year renewal probability with referenceability.

Asking for: 
1) Commercial exception: custom tier with a variable breakpoint and a capped blended rate.
2) One-time onboarding credit (amount proposed by Ben below).

Can you advise on guardrails (minimum ASP, effective gross margin, and required controls — audit clause, usage floors)? If acceptable, can we route for VP/CFO signoff?

Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Packaging question — annual commitment and tiered usage

Putting numbers on the table for discussion. See attached pricing-breakdown-ACC-1034.xlsx. Proposed commercial framework: 

- Term: 24 months, annual billing.
- Volume tiers (monthly): 0–50M @ $0.0009/token; 50–150M @ $0.00055/token; >150M @ $0.00045/token (for any overages).
- Blended guarantee: minimum annual commitment $1.2M (gives us floor economics).
- One-time onboarding credit: $60k applied to first invoice (covers fine-tuning & embeddings).
- Audit & cap: right to audit usage quarterly, overage protections, and a 90-day usage review to rebase tiers if consumption differs materially.

Margin check (high-level): at proposed tiers we stay above acceptable blended margin assuming standard GPU execution profiles and moderate batching. Laura, need confirmation this passes finance constraints. Ben

Attachments: pricing-breakdown-ACC-1034.xlsx (stub)
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 13:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Packaging question — annual commitment and tiered usage

Thanks for the numbers. Quick notes from finance: 

- Onboarding credit of $60k is acceptable if tied to a $1.2M minimum ARR commitment and clear deliverables (SOW milestones).
- Minimum ASP floor must be $0.00055 effective blended over the first 6 months; any deviation requires reprice.
- Require a 12% gross margin floor on expected run-rate cost; if usage skews heavily to high-seq fine-tuning, we need to renegotiate GPU-backed costs.

If those conditions are OK from sales, we'll need markus to approve an exception memo to the VP/CFO packet. Please draft a one-page memo with: deal economics, strategic rationale, guardrails, and suggested approval language.

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec memo for Acceleron exception — request for signoff

Markus / Marissa — per Laura's ask, attached is a one-page memo and the SOW draft. Summary below: 

Deal: Acceleron Pharma — pilot -> enterprise roll. 
Value: $1.2M minimum ARR + expected expansion to $3M+ ARR if adoption scales.
Ask: Approve a custom blended tier and a one-time $60k onboarding credit tied to SOW milestones. 
Guardrails proposed: 
- Minimum effective blended ASP floor: $0.00055 (first 6 months)
- Audit rights quarterly; reprice trigger if monthly usage deviates >30% from forecast for two consecutive quarters
- Onboarding credit paid as credit on invoice contingent on milestone sign-off (data ingestion, fine-tune job completion, embeddings deliverable)

Recommendation: Approve conditionally (require VP/CFO signoff) and allow Sales to finalize with Procurement. If approved, I will communicate to Acceleron and update HubSpot.

Attachments: Acceleron_SOW_v3.pdf (stub), one-page-exception-memo-ACC-1034.docx (embedded in memo)

I reviewed the memo and financial addendum. Approve in principle with the following caveats: 

1) Onboarding credit cap remains $60k but is non-refundable and applied only after milestone acceptance.
2) Include a clause: Redwood may pause new model training if anomalous consumption or abuse is detected pending joint remediation.
3) Require finance checkpoint at 6 months to validate realized margin; if margin <12%, executive review required and commercial terms may be renegotiated.

Marissa — would you sign off on the exec memo + approval language below? If yes, we can push final to procurement and cc Acceleron's legal team.

-Markus
